claim: In a February 28, 2016 email to investor Peter Thiel — released in the DOJ's Epstein Files Transparency Act production (Data Set 9, Bates EFTA00832976) — Jeffrey Epstein wrote "as you probably know I represent the Rothschilds," and proposed finding a way for "the bank that has 160 b in mgmt" to "do something in tech." Epstein's largest known benefactor, Leslie Wexner, separately told the House Oversight Committee in a February 18, 2026 deposition that among the credentials Epstein presented to him was personal financial work for the Rothschild family in France. The documents establish that Epstein made and circulated the Rothschild-representation claim; they do not, on their own, establish what "represent" meant or that any such mandate existed.

sources.label: DOJ Epstein Files Transparency Act production, Data Set 9, Bates EFTA00832976 — Jeffrey Epstein email to Peter Thiel, 02/28/2016.
sources.quote: as you probably know I represent the Rothschilds. I was hoping to figure out a way for the bank that has 160 b in mgmt can do something in tech. best client list in the world , prehistoric products. - it can wait.

notes: Centerpiece is our own corpus primary: EFTA00832976 (DS9), Epstein->Thiel, 2016-02-28, verbatim line 'as you probably know I represent the Rothschilds.'
